ALTER VIEW [DW].[DateFilter]
	AS
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactLoansRelationshipExposure
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactLoansOutstandingBalance
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactLoansCreditLimit
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactCardsCreditLimit
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactCardsOutstandingBalance
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactSecurityPortfolio
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactTrustFundValue
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
    UNION
    Select businessdatesk from dw.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
